a260824p1.summary: Prominent AI researcher Luke Metz has joined Meta's Superintelligence Labs, a source familiar with the matter confirmed to Axios.
a260824p1.title: Source: AI researcher Luke Metz, who returned to OpenAI from TML earlier this year, joins Meta's Superintelligence Labs and will report to Alexandr Wang (Ina Fried/Axios)

a260824p2.summary: New Zealand plans to ban under-16s from social media, joining a throng of countries worldwide seeking to limit online harm to children.
a260824p2.title: New Zealand plans a bill to ban social media for under-16s, requiring "high risk" platforms to check user ages or face penalties of up to 10% of global revenue (Tracy Withers/Bloomberg)

a260824p3.summary: The bloc struggles to keep up with US spending on high-tech equipment and facilities
a260824p3.title: Oxford Economics: US corporate spending on equipment and facilities is set to rise 40% between 2021 and 2027, over 3x faster than Europe, driven by the AI race (Financial Times)
